# instaling-bot

> Open-source desktop app and CLI bot for practising vocabulary on instaling.pl.
> Windows 10/11 and macOS 13+ desktop app with a bundled Chrome for Testing;
> Node.js 22+ CLI for Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Canonical

- Website: https://bmonekkk.github.io/instaling-bot/
- Repository: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot
- Latest release: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/releases/latest
- Wiki: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/wiki
- Discussions: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/discussions
- Security policy: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/blob/master/SECURITY.md
- English README: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/blob/master/README.en.md

## What it is

instaling-bot automates vocabulary practice on instaling.pl. It logs in, starts or
resumes a session, reads each prompt, answers with a configurable accuracy, remembers
translations and can make believable mistakes (empty field, different translation or a
typo) for human-like behaviour. Everything runs locally; there is no backend or telemetry.

Version 3.2.0 includes week, month, year and all-time statistics, repeating reminders,
a full CLI (`start`, `stats`, `remind`, `update-check`, `help`, `version`) and update
checks before the CLI starts. The desktop interface is available in Polish and English.

## Install

- Windows: `instaling-bot-3.2.0-setup-win64.exe` from the latest release.
- macOS: `instaling-bot-3.2.0-macos-arm64.pkg` or `instaling-bot-3.2.0-macos-x64.pkg`.
- Linux / terminal: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/master/install.sh | bash`

## Notes

- License: ISC.
- Language: Polish-first documentation, English README and support; the desktop UI switches between Polish and English.
- Installers are unsigned; SmartScreen and Gatekeeper may warn on first launch.
- The project is educational, is not affiliated with InstaLing and is not intended to cheat.
